correctness.rationale: The limit calculation is valid. Property \((M)\) equates the limsup of \(\|x+e_n\|\) with the explicit model center \(\|\|x\|e_0+e_n\|\); applying the same identity to every subsequence upgrades the limsup to a full limit \(L_c(\|x\|)=\max\{1,\sqrt{\|x\|^2+c^2}\}\). The diagonal coefficient perturbation \(n/(n+1)\to1\) then gives the numerator limit \(L_c(\|D_cx\|)\). For \(\|x\|\le\sqrt{1-c^2}\) both limits equal one, while strict norm decrease of the published witness on nonzero vectors makes the quotient strictly below one outside that ball. Weak convergence follows from \(e_n\rightharpoonup0\) and the denominator tending to one. The boundary and zero cases are included, and the result correctly limits itself to this one-spike family.
